column1: # TITLE: Transcriptomic analysis of TDRD9-depleted lung tumor cells

# SUMMARY: Tudor domain containing protein 9 (TDRD9) is a RNA helicase normally expressed in the germline. We have shown that TDRD9 is highly expressed in a subset of non-small cell lung carcinomas. Here we determine the transcriptomic changes of a TDRD9-positive lung tumor cells line (NCI-H1993) depleted of TDRD9.
